summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), following the seven-step procedure in the spec. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized valid/invalid test covering every error branch, plus tests for non-node inputs, Literal input, and graph immutability. Results: the new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the shared venv's Python. Not verified: mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in that venv, so type-checking and lint gates were not run; type-ignore placement and line lengths (all within 88) were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed, and no existing modules were modified.
